name: Kustomer
description: Kustomer is a customer-service CRM for omnichannel conversations, customer timelines, agent workflows, routing, automation, knowledge, reporting, and service operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned Kustomer API key, then let selected agents use content-free conversation operations or approved documented API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: KUSTOMER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Kustomer API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated expiring API key with only the roles required by selected operations; Kustomer shows the key only once.

capabilities.label: Read conversation operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded conversation operational metadata without names, previews, customers, messages, notes, satisfaction, tags, custom fields, relationships, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Kustomer API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented fixed-origin API v1 paths and methods allowed by the connected key's roles.

approvalRequired.label: List conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Kustomer conversation summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Kustomer conversation through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Kustomer API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Kustomer API v1 operation authorized by the API key roles; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free conversation reads and every broader API operation require approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, key roles, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, bounds, audits, roles, and Kustomer limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the fixed Kustomer API v1 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the fixed Kustomer API v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Kustomer API key with appropriate conversation and selected-operation roles is required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated expiring Kustomer API key with least-privilege roles, enter it in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, rate limits, key rotation, role removal, expiry, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Kustomer's official developer documentation defines organization API keys, role assignment, expiry, one-time key display, Bearer authorization, fixed API origin, API v1 paths, and customer-owned key handling.
Kustomer's official API-method documentation defines GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE relative API requests and the /v1/conversations/{id} resource shape used by the bounded connector projection.
